description: Implementation of the ue_cell_repository class managing UE cells, including handling HARQ timeouts, adding and removing UEs, and related operations within a scheduler context.

classes.name: harq_manager_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Handles HARQ timeout notifications and invokes metrics handler callbacks.

methods.name: on_harq_timeout
methods.description: Callback for HARQ timeout event, triggers metrics handler.

methods.name: on_feedback_disabled_harq_timeout
methods.description: Callback for HARQ feedback disabled event, triggers metrics handler if downlink.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::ue_cell_repository
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UE cell repository with configuration and metrics handler.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::slot_indication
methods.description: Processes slot indication, handling HARQ timeouts.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::deactivate
methods.description: Stops HARQ timers and deactivates the repository.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the repository, creating necessary components.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository::rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the repository and cleans up resources.
